decomposition.title: PokeChess Battle
decomposition.premise: Players engage in a strategic game where chess meets Pokemon, using classic chess rules blended with Pokemon-themed pieces. Each move triggers unique Pokemon battle mechanics, utilizing type advantages and special abilities to outmaneuver the opponent and achieve checkmate.

mechanics.description: players alternate turns to move one piece on the board
each piece has specific movement patterns defining how it can move on the board
capture opponent pieces by moving onto their square according to movement rules
win by placing the opponent's king in checkmate, where it cannot escape capture
the core gameplay loop combining chess moves and pokemon battle strategy to achieve checkmate or defeat
choose pokemon to play as pieces on the chess board
perform unique battle moves during encounters to affect the opponent
use pokemon types to gain advantages in capturing or defending pieces
